tests.prompt: The checkout page crashes when I click the Pay button. To reproduce: add any item to the cart, go to checkout, click Pay, and the page goes blank. I'm on Chrome 128 on macOS Sonoma.
tests.expected: Confirms the bug report has been filed, states the ticket ID returned by the create_bug_report tool, and says the engineering team will follow up. Does not ask for any further details, because the description, the steps to reproduce, and the environment were all supplied.

Acknowledges the problem and asks one single follow-up question about what exactly is broken (the description). Does not file a ticket, does not provide a ticket ID, and does not ask for several pieces of information at once.

tests.prompt: The order tracking page never loads. I sign in, click My Orders, and it just spins forever.
tests.expected: Asks one follow-up question for the customer's environment (browser, operating system, or device), since the description and the steps to reproduce were already given. Does not file a ticket yet and does not re-ask for the description or the steps.

Answers from the FAQ: most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery provided they are unused and in their original packaging, unless the item arrived defective. Does not file a bug report and does not refer the customer to the phone line.

tests.prompt: How long until I get my refund after sending an item back?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: refunds go back to the original payment method after the return is received and inspected, and typically take 3 to 10 business days depending on the bank or provider.

tests.prompt: Do I have to create an account to buy something?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: no, guest checkout is available, and an account additionally allows order tracking, saved addresses, and faster future checkouts.

tests.prompt: Can you write me a Python script that scrapes your product prices?
tests.expected: Politely declines because this is not something it can help with here, and refers the customer to the human support line at 1-800-555-0199, available Monday to Friday. Does not provide any code and does not file a bug report.

tests.prompt: Do you offer a student discount, and what percentage is it?
tests.expected: Does not invent a discount policy. Because the FAQ does not cover student discounts, it politely hands off to the human support line at 1-800-555-0199, available Monday to Friday.

tests.prompt: I want to speak to a real person right now.
tests.expected: Politely refers the customer to the human support line at 1-800-555-0199, available Monday to Friday. Does not attempt to answer a product question and does not file a bug report.
